links.outcome: Answer accuracy on the retrospective case-based question set (also highest on the knowledge-based set); context-irrelevant errors
links.effect: Case-based set: GraphRAG 71.12% vs DocRAG 62.47% average accuracy. Knowledge-based set: GraphRAG 96.89% (multiple-choice) and 66.44% (open-ended), the highest average accuracy. GraphRAG reduced context-irrelevant errors compared with DocRAG.
links.quote: On the retrospective case-based question set, GraphRAG also showed the strongest overall performance, with an average accuracy of 71.12%, compared with 62.47% for DocRAG, 54.20% for CoT, 52.67% for Vanilla, and 52.54% for RoT.
